dz: 罗马皇帝塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁斯(Septimius Severus)在埃博拉库姆(英国现代约克)准备领导一场反对喀里多尼亚人的运动时去世后,帝国被他的两个争吵的儿子卡拉卡拉和盖塔所控制,他已经指示他们要和好.
de: Following the death of the Roman Emperor Septimius Severus at Eboracum (modern York, England) while preparing to lead a campaign against the Caledonians, the empire is left in the control of his two quarrelling sons, Caracalla and Geta, whom he had instructed to make peace.
